provenance: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS) Atmospheres & Geosciences Nodes

opportunity.name: MER Opportunity (MER-B)
opportunity.fate: Lost contact on Sol 5111 during 2018 Planet-Encircling Dust Storm (tau=10.8, Wh=22). Mission officially concluded Sol 5352 after 1,000+ recovery attempts.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 420 Miracle Cleaning Event
cleaningEvents.desc: Famous March 2005 cleaning event. Convective dust devil swept panels, jumping Df from 0.61 to 0.93 overnight and boosting daily energy to >800 Wh.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 640 Dust Gust Cleaning
cleaningEvents.desc: Erebus crater rim wind gusts lifted dust, increasing transmission by +8%.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 706 Southern Summer Vortex
cleaningEvents.desc: Passing thermal vortex dislodged accumulated dust during southern summer.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 1120 Pre-Storm Vortex Cleaning
cleaningEvents.desc: Major clearing event on the approach to Victoria Crater, raising Df from 0.62 to 0.86 (+300 Wh).

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 1320 Post-2007 GDS Cleaning
cleaningEvents.desc: Post-storm convective clearing event helping Opportunity recover after the 2007 Global Dust Storm.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 1550 Duck Bay Clearing
cleaningEvents.desc: Winds inside Victoria crater cleaned array wing panels.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 1780 Southern Spring Gust
cleaningEvents.desc: Vortex cleaning jumped Df from 0.51 to 0.72 (+220 Wh).

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 2200 Southern Summer Cleaning Storm
cleaningEvents.desc: Series of strong clearing gusts at Concepcion Crater, raising Df from 0.48 to 0.73.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 2600 Endeavour Approach Cleaning
cleaningEvents.desc: Strong cleaning event as rover approached Spirit Point on rim of Endeavour Crater.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 3050 Matijevic Hill Clearing
cleaningEvents.desc: Convective clearing boosted winter array output by +14%.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 3550 'Miracle Cleaning' Event
cleaningEvents.desc: Second largest cleaning event of mission. Df jumped from 0.47 to 0.78 (+70% power surge), saving the upcoming winter operations.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 4000 Marathon Valley Cleaning
cleaningEvents.desc: Spring vortex cleaning during Marathon Valley survey, boosting Df to 0.82.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 4400 Perseverance Valley Clearing
cleaningEvents.desc: Strong seasonal wind cleaning before descending Perseverance Valley.

cleaningEvents.name: Sol 4700 Ridge Clearing
cleaningEvents.desc: Final major natural cleaning event of mission, restoring Df to 0.84 prior to the 2018 storm.

insight.name: InSight Lander
insight.fate: Power declined relentlessly due to absence of vortex clearing events at Elysium Planitia. Fell below 300 Wh/sol survival threshold in Dec 2022 (Sol 1440).

counterCleaningEvent.name: Robotic Arm Sand Counter-Cleaning Maneuver
counterCleaningEvent.desc: Robotic arm scoop trickled sand upwind of arrays. Wind carried grains across solar cells, dislodging dust and generating +30 Wh/sol.
